64501.description:
A broken world in the not-so distant future.
Humanity is facing a new incident.

"We’re being attacked by humans who should be dead."

The government has decided to request a specialized organization to deal with this situation.
The Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis, commonly known as "LONA."
Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead.

What do people think of, and what do they leave behind before they die?
Countless memories engraved in the neural circuits. What did they see in those deep depths?

(Source: LONA Official Site)
synonyms: Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis

64503.description: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen.

64505.description:
The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the national title are the winners of last year's summer tournament Komadai Fujimaki and their unstoppable ace Masamune Hongo. Can Seido triumph over Komadai? It's the start of another heated battle in youth baseball!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.english: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-

title.romaji: Diamond no Ace act II: Second Season Part 2

64506.description: Animated music video for Ikka Dumb Rock!'s debut song Homie's Tie!!.

64509.description: Jixia College has come up with a surprise move, inviting outstanding graduates to return as temporary "substitute teachers"! Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang Zhan launch a "dual-teacher showdown," with Yao and the "Star Team" and current students creating hilarious daily interactions with their seniors. When a mysterious crisis strikes, teachers and students set aside their identities and join forces to fight. Amid endless blunders and passionate moments of fighting side by side, the unique story of Jixia's legacy continues.

64519.description:
Special short commemorating the 10th anniversary of the Bananya series.

When I woke up, I was in an unfamiliar world.
In front of me was a cat peeking out of a banana, a "Bananya."
I couldn't believe my eyes. For some reason, my body was also made of a banana...

(Source: TMS Anime Official YouTube Channel, translated)

title.native: ばなにゃ あっとほーむぱーてぃー

64520.description:
That boy could see sound. Luca, a boy with branches sprouting from his head, serves as a bugler in a mercenary company that thrives on war. Though surrounded by conflict, he dreams of becoming a musician. One day, amid the chaos of battle, a mysterious power awakens within him. His journey soon brings him into contact with the Pontiff, who stands at the pinnacle of the nation; Zoe, a fellow Branch-Born; and many others whose lives are intertwined with his own. Through these encounters, Luca's destiny begins to change in ways he could never have imagined. Arboral Year 1294—a battle that will determine the future is about to begin.

(Source: Producer Trailer)

title.english: The Bugle Call: Song of War

title.native: マリッジトキシン 第2期

64527.description:
Soara is a young orphan girl who was raised by knights and trained to battle the monsters that constantly attacked their kingdom. But by the time Soara is ready to join the fight herself, peace has been declared and her blade is no longer needed. Searching for a new home and a new purpose, Soara stumbles across Krik the dwarf, leader of the Monster Architects. Suddenly, instead of fighting monsters, Soara finds herself working with Krik to build comfortable homes for them! In the process, will she discover a new home and family for herself?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

64528.description:
Amelia, the kingdom of dragons with a monopoly on magical power, is once again invading other lands with the ferocious Queen Amelia at its head. Her eyes are set on Campusfellow, the small land of fire and iron, which at this rate will inevitably fall… For the sake of the country’s survival, Lord Bud Grace comes up with a last-resort plan—ally with the one known only as the Witch, the subject of countless terrifying tales. With the assassin Rollo, known as “Black Dog” and versed in every method of killing, at their disposal, they set out to enter an alliance with the first witch, also known as the Mirror Witch…

(Source: Yen Press)

64529.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Sensouya-san (戦争屋さん).

Coleus, a knight-in-training, attends a training academy. His new instructor turns out to be his childhood friend, Artel. "It's been a long time, Coleus." Coleus rejoices at reuniting with Artel, who has grown into a beautiful and strong woman. However, Artel quickly incurs the wrath of a fellow instructor, Lock. Lock, plotting to bring Artel down, seizes her wicked hands and robs her of her mental freedom. In front of her childhood friend, her voluptuous breasts are ravaged, and her virginity is taken. Lock's brutal acts escalate, and while Artel remains unconscious, her body, trained as a female knight, is transformed into that of a female. The joy of their reunion is the beginning of a nightmare. The proud knight's soul is corrupted (NTR) by a despicable trap.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

64530.description:
Meiko, a beautiful, quiet, and academically gifted classmate, only shows her relaxed side in front of her childhood friend, Hiroki. Today, she comes to his room to hang out, and Hiroki can't help but glance at her body as she relaxes in light clothing. When she points it out, Hiroki blushes with embarrassment, but Meiko unexpectedly asks, "Well, do you want to touch me?" Their curiosity leads them to explore each other's bodies, which eventually escalates to sex...

(Source: PinkPineapple, translated)

title.native: 無自覚な幼馴染と興味本位でヤってみたら THE ANIMATION
title.romaji: Mujikaku na Osananajimi to Kyoumi Honi de Yatte Mitara THE ANIMATION

64531.description:
Koto Tenryuuji acts completely indifferent and aloof. She’s the daughter of a massive conglomerate—a true “unattainable beauty”—but with just a single hypnotic suggestion, she turns into a love-struck girlfriend! Convinced of his false affection, she starts seeking him out on her own… Even though it’s her first time, she cums over and over just from being touched! With her actively seeking him out, he savors every inch of her body all day long, leaving nothing to be desired! No matter how many times he cums inside her, no matter how many times he makes her come, she feels nothing but happiness…!?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

64534.description:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by…

(Source: Netflix)

64535.description:
Yuan Juntang and Li Shiya successfully joined hands, beginning the dream campus romance everyone had dreamed of. However, as the sweet filter gradually fades, feelings of inferiority, confusion, and growing pains arrive as expected. When passionate love collides with realistic dreams, they tug between compromise and being side by side, and this symphony of youth will ultimately face its final decision.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

64537.hashtag: #レッツロールシナモロール　#LetsRollCinnamoroll

title.native: レッツロールシナモロール

64540.description:
Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

64541.description: A movie celebrating the Aikatsu Stars's 10th anniversary.

title.native: アイカツスターズ！ ～星々のProgress～

64542.description:
A new recruit has started working at the "Cheat Item Management Bureau, Victim Recovery Department," a division responsible for protecting and recovering victims of various cheat items that allow for manipulation and time stopping. He heads to an empty apartment in a housing complex that should be deserted, only to find women who have been abused again and again. His job is to protect them, heal them, make them forget everything, and release them. Then one day, his senior tells him, "You can handle the rest on your own." After this, the victims will be released and forgotten anyway...no one will see...so maybe I can...have a little taste...?

(Source: Fanza, translated)

64552.description: The youngest A-rank adventurer, child prodigy Kaizer, finds three babies who were the only survivor of a destroyed village. Then he decided to give up his job as an adventurer and raise them. Over time, the girls grow brightly and show exceptional talents in fencing, magic and management. However, these girls also seem to love their father, Kaiser!

64555.description:
Mass murderers may not have much by way of career skills, but Kuroko Koumori seems to have landed her dream job as a hitwoman for the Tokyo police! A license to kill other killers? That's some serious job satisfaction, right there!

(Source: Yen Press)

64556.description:
The main staff of The Apothecary Diaries are reuniting for an all-new original anime project titled "Jurassic Shadows"

Tokyo, 2029 -
Long believed to have vanished after the asteroid impact that caused their extinction, dinosaurs secretly survived by passing their DNA into humanity through interbreeding. Hidden among ordinary people, they now prey upon humans while living unnoticed within society.
Standing against them is a covert order of ninjas who wield Ryugesho, a special pigment infused with ancient memories. By applying this mysterious pigment, they awaken the powers of dinosaurs within themselves and fight back against the predators threatening humanity.
As the dinosaurs launch their campaign to wipe out humankind, the ninjas rise to stop them.
The battle for the survival of two species begins.

(Source: YouTube Description)

64558.description: Animated music video for YOASOBI × Overwatch's collaboration song Orion.

64562.description:

The third Medicine Seller "Inui no Tsurugi" has been revealed in a promotional video!

64564.description:
Music video for the song Ichijiku Kemuri by ZUTOMAYO.

Note: The song featured in this video also serves as the opening theme in the anime Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari.

64569.description:
I want to wake up the princess who was put to sleep by a witch's curse… but there are seven of them! So it seems that I have to kiss...... seven girls! Now the princesses are awake, but the other people in the kingdom are still asleep...... Why? Is there more to breaking the curse than just a kiss or am I still missing something......?

Alec is the third prince of Rudbekia who wants to save the kingdom of Amaryllis and its seven princesses. In a country where only they are awake, they must work together to save everyone from the curse!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

64573.description:
"If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married."

Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom!

(Source: K MANGA)

title.native: 私をセンターにすると誓いますか？
title.romaji: Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasuka?

64577.description:
The second season of Youjo Shenki.

Chibi parody of Youjo Senki.

64578.description:
The anime centers on Kikkun, an extraterrestrial life form who came from a distant planet to invade Earth. But the invasion team members assigned in Japan finds the country comfortable, and now wants to protect Japan and Earth, forgetting their original motive.

(Source: Anime News Network)

64580.description:
Set in August 1987, the story follows one day in the life of Tokko as she stays at home in a large house while her family is away.

(Source: Anime News Network)

64584.description:
Six years after the story first began as a manhua, Mo Lang and Bai Qi’s journey is finally making its way to the screen.

Spinning off as a series from the world of Scissor Seven, this new chapter takes us back to where another adventure began — with the meeting of two boys and the start of a thrilling journey.

64597.description: A short animation for Mob Psycho 100 to commemorate the anime series’ tenth milestone that debuted at the “Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Reunion Event" in Fukagawa Mirai Hall.

title.native: モブサイコ100 10周年記念特別映像
title.romaji: Mob Psycho 100: 10 Shuunen Kinen Tokubetsu Eizou

64599.description:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."

Working at a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? The is the start of a workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend.
